purpose: D-019 preregistered decision rule, committed BEFORE any regenerated ranking is computed or viewed
verdict_rule: After repair, recompute the frozen H1/H2 metrics and the preregistered section-7 useful-effect thresholds over the regenerated data. If the repaired data change whether ANY frozen useful-effect threshold is passed, the scientific verdict is REOPENED. Otherwise H1 (falsified), H2 (falsified) and PIVOT stand. No verdict is declared immune in advance.
impact_radius_rule: The affected set is frozen in d019-impact-scan.json (7 windows / 7 cases). If regeneration changes any stable result field of any case OUTSIDE that set, regeneration results are NOT accepted until the excess change is root-caused and separately adjudicated.
alert_scope_rule: Resolved by the pre-result structural scan (d019-alert-scope-scan.json, reads only OLD canonical data): if log_pods is a subset of span_pods for every span-containing session in all 105 windows, adopt session_pods = span_pods UNION log_pods globally; otherwise adopt the minimal compatibility rule (span_pods when spans exist, log_pods for log-only sessions) and record the union semantics as a potential separate future change, not part of this bugfix.
counter_rules: traceids_listed keeps its historical meaning (raw rows); new counters traceids_unique, traceids_duplicate_entries, log_only_sessions_emitted, traceids_without_events. Source duplicate counters must remain NONZERO where the input file has duplicates; conservation quantities (duplicate_session_seq_pairs, accepted_span_rows_unemitted, accepted_log_rows_unemitted) must be zero.
